rajpur-road.name: Rajpur Road
rajpur-road.about:
Rajpur Road is one of the main roads of Dehradun, running from the city centre near the Clock Tower and Paltan Bazaar up the valley towards Mussoorie. It is a wide, tree-lined road with a long-settled residential feel: old bungalows and independent houses sit behind a busy frontage of shops, showrooms, restaurants and hotels, while flats, villas, builder floors and plots fill the lanes further up. Race Course, Karanpur, Subhash Road and Kalidas Road are among its neighbouring areas.

For tutors, the road is easy to reach from almost anywhere in the city, and Dehradun railway station and the ISBT are both within reach for anyone travelling in from further afield; auto-rickshaws and shared three-wheelers cover the last stretch. Independent houses usually mean arrival at the door, while apartment buildings may ask the guard to note the tutor's name. The lower stretch near the city centre is busiest during evening shopping hours, so agree a fixed early-evening slot, and use online sessions when the right subject specialist lives across the valley. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

karanpur.name: Karanpur
karanpur.about:
Karanpur is a central Dehradun locality close to Rajpur Road and Subhash Road, with Kalidas Road, Chukkuwala, Kewal Vihar, Shakti Colony and Rishi Nagar around it and the Raipur Road side just to the east. Its housing is mostly builder floors and small apartment buildings with shops mixed in, and with colleges close by it is well known as a student neighbourhood, including for young people preparing for government exams.

This makes Karanpur a lively, compact area rather than a quiet colony, and many families live in builder floors or flats above or behind shops. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler, which is far easier to park in the lanes than a car, and a precise landmark such as a shop name or lane number saves time on the first visit. Roads around the college area fill up when classes end in the afternoon, so slots a little later in the evening tend to start on time. Because so many tutors and students already live in and around Karanpur, families here often find a nearby match quickly, and online classes cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dalanwala.name: Dalanwala
dalanwala.about:
Dalanwala is an established residential area just east of central Dehradun, known for its green, quiet lanes and spacious independent homes. Independent houses and plots make up most of the housing, with some villas, builder floors and a few apartment buildings. Its neighbours include Race Course, Nehru Colony, Subhash Road, Araghar, Dharampur, Shivlok Colony, Chander Nagar and the Raipur Road side.

Because most homes here are independent houses, tutors can usually walk up to the door, and there is generally room to park a two-wheeler or car on the lane outside. Dehradun railway station is close for anyone arriving by train. The proposed Metro Neo east-west corridor towards Raipur would pass nearby through Araghar Chowk and Nehru Colony, but it is still only at the planning stage, so tutors come by road. Share a clear lane landmark for the first visit. During the monsoon months, when heavy showers can slow travel across the city, a short online session is a useful way to keep the week's class on track. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jakhan.name: Jakhan
jakhan.about:
Jakhan is a residential area on the upper stretch of Rajpur Road, which passes through it and links it with Karanpur and Kandholi along the valley. Housing is a mix of independent houses, villas, builder floors, apartments and plots, with many larger family homes, and Canal Road, Bhagirathi Puram, Kishanpur, Rajeshwar Nagar and the Sahastradhara Road side are close neighbours. Residents often describe it as greener and a little cooler than the city centre.

For home tuition, Jakhan suits tutors who already live in the Rajpur Road, Kishanpur or Canal Road belt, since they can reach it without crossing the busy centre. Most arrive by two-wheeler or car. The shopping and restaurant stretch of Rajpur Road around Jakhan is busy in the evenings, so a weekday slot that starts before the rush is easier to keep. Apartment complexes usually register visitors at the gate, while independent houses mean arrival at the door. In winter, when evenings turn cold early in the upper valley, many families prefer slightly earlier class timings. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

rajpur.name: Rajpur
rajpur.about:
Rajpur is the old settlement at the upper end of Rajpur Road, at the foot of the hills that rise towards Mussoorie, and it is the site of the Shahanshahi Ashram. Mussoorie Road, Kulhan, Tarla Nagal, Kishanpur and Malsi are its neighbours. Because it sits a little higher than central Dehradun, it is known for its greenery, open views and cooler air. Homes range from independent houses and villas on the slopes to flats in newer buildings.

Rajpur is at the edge of the city, so the most practical home tutors are usually those living in Jakhan, Kishanpur or Malsi rather than in the old centre. Many houses are set back from the main road, so send the tutor a map pin and a landmark before the first class. Weekday afternoon or early-evening slots work well, and in the winter months, when it gets dark and cold early on the hillside, starting a little earlier helps. For subjects where no suitable tutor lives on this side of the city, online classes are a practical choice. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

malsi.name: Malsi
malsi.about:
Malsi is a residential area on the Mussoorie Road side of north Dehradun, widely known for the Malsi Deer Park. Housing is mainly apartments of one to four bedrooms in newer complexes, along with independent houses, villas and plots, and residents describe it as green and peaceful. Its neighbours include Johri, Sinaula, Jakhan, Rajpur, Kishanpur, Anarwala, Danion Ka Danda and the Dehradun Cantonment area.

Much of the newer housing here is in gated complexes, so families should register the tutor at the main gate and ask whether a regular visitor pass can be issued after the demo. Tutors mostly come by two-wheeler or car up from the Jakhan and Rajpur Road side. Weekday evening slots are usually easier to keep than weekend ones, when more traffic heads up the valley. In the cold winter months, many families shift classes a little earlier, and on heavy-rain days in the monsoon an online session is a simple way to avoid a missed class. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sahastradhara-road.name: Sahastradhara Road
sahastradhara-road.about:
Sahastradhara Road runs north-east from the city towards the Sahastradhara springs and has become one of Dehradun's main corridors for new housing. Apartments make up much of the rental supply, with builder floors, independent houses, villas and residential plots as well, and the lower stretch also has an office park and hotels. Aman Vihar, Canal Road, Govind Vihar, Jakhan, Rajeshwar Nagar and Bima Vihar are neighbouring localities.

With so many apartment complexes, most tutor visits here begin at a society gate, so give the guard the tutor's name and flat number before the demo class. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler or car, and those living in Kishanpur, Canal Road or Jakhan have the simplest journeys. Traffic builds on the lower stretch at office closing time, so a slot either before or well after that peak works better. On heavy-rain days in the monsoon, families often switch that day's class online rather than cancel it, and online tutors are also useful for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kishanpur.name: Kishanpur
kishanpur.about:
Kishanpur is a residential locality in north Dehradun, close to where Sahastradhara Road leaves the Rajpur Road belt. Apartments make up most of its housing, in both newer complexes and smaller buildings, with independent houses, villas and builder floors as well. Canal Road, Govind Vihar, Rajpur, Jakhan, Rajeshwar Nagar, Johri, Tarla Nagal, Bima Vihar and Danda Lakhond are among its neighbours.

Kishanpur sits between the Rajpur Road and Sahastradhara Road corridors, so it draws tutors from both sides of the north of the city. Apartment complexes usually ask visitors to sign in, so let the gate know the tutor's name before the first visit and check where a two-wheeler can be parked. Evening traffic picks up on the nearby main roads after office hours, so a fixed weekday slot agreed in advance keeps classes regular. In the winter months many families prefer an earlier start, and online classes cover subjects where the right tutor lives elsewhere in the valley. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

raipur-road.name: Raipur Road (Raipur)
raipur-road.about:
Raipur Road leads east from the Sahastradhara crossing towards Raipur, an area long associated with defence production establishments. The road is lined with residential colonies offering plots, flats, builder floors, villas and independent houses. Dalanwala, Sahastradhara Road, Chironwali, Ekta Vihar, Subhash Road, Karanpur, Kewal Vihar, Ladpur and Curzon Road are among its neighbours.

The proposed Metro Neo east-west corridor would end at Raipur, with planned stops such as Upper Nathanpur, Ordnance Factory and Hathikhana Chowk, but it has not been approved for construction, so tutors travel by two-wheeler, car or auto. Ask whether the home is an independent house with doorstep arrival or a flat with a building gate, and share a colony landmark. Families further out towards Raipur may find fewer tutors living close by, so a tutor from Dalanwala, Karanpur or Sahastradhara Road, or an online class for specialist subjects, is a practical choice. Agree a regular slot outside the evening rush near the crossing. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

race-course.name: Race Course
race-course.about:
Race Course is a long-settled residential area south-east of the Dehradun city centre, with Araghar, New Road, Chander Nagar, Dalanwala and Darshanlal Chowk among the places around it. Its housing is dominated by individual plots and independent homes, followed by apartments of two and three bedrooms, and wide roads connect it to Haridwar Road and the neighbouring localities.

Being so close to the centre, Race Course is easy for tutors coming from Dalanwala, Nehru Colony, Karanpur or the Rajpur Road side. Most tutors use a two-wheeler or auto, and the house-and-plot layout usually means arrival at the door with space to park nearby. The proposed Metro Neo corridor would have a stop at Araghar Chowk next door, but the project is still only at the planning stage. Junctions towards Haridwar Road get busy at office hours, so pick a weekday slot outside that peak. Online classes help when a specialist tutor lives across the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

nehru-colony.name: Nehru Colony
nehru-colony.about:
Nehru Colony is an established locality in south-east Dehradun, just off Haridwar Road and near Fuwara Chowk, known for its markets and older housing. Daily needs such as a vegetable market, banks, shops and coaching centres are close at hand. Housing includes independent houses, flats and villas, while the adjoining Dharampur Nehru Colony has plots, villas and builder floors. Dalanwala, Ajabpur, Araghar, Ganesh Vihar, Upper Nathanpur, Dharampur and Jagriti Vihar are its neighbours.

Tyagi Road links the colony with the ISBT, and Dehradun railway station is close by, so tutors from many parts of the city can reach it easily; a two-wheeler is the most practical choice in the market lanes. The proposed Metro Neo corridor towards Raipur includes a planned Nehru Colony stop, but it is not under construction. Market streets are busiest in the evening, so share an exact lane landmark and fix a regular slot. Independent houses mean arrival at the door, while flats may need the guard to be informed. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jogiwala.name: Jogiwala
jogiwala.about:
Jogiwala is an old, settled part of south-east Dehradun that has grown into a junction area linking several parts of the city. Jogiwala Chowk connects directly with the main Haridwar highway and the ring road, and the locality mixes homes with shops and local eateries. Housing is mostly independent houses, villas and plots, with some newer apartment buildings. Badripur, Banjarawala, Mohkampur, Nehrugram, Nehru Colony, Kedar Puram and Defence Colony are nearby.

Its junction position helps tutors: someone living in Nehru Colony, Mohkampur or along Haridwar Road can usually reach a home here without crossing the city centre. Most tutors come by two-wheeler or auto. The chowk itself is busy at office hours, so classes timed outside that window start more reliably. In house-and-plot lanes, the tutor can arrive at the door, while apartment buildings may keep a visitor register. On heavy-rain days in the monsoon, an online session keeps the week's routine going, and online tutors also cover subjects where no specialist lives nearby. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

doiwala.name: Doiwala
doiwala.about:
Doiwala is a town on the Dehradun-Haridwar road, National Highway 7, that sits roughly between Dehradun, Haridwar and Rishikesh. It is both a nagar palika with its own elected ward councillors and a tehsil of Dehradun district. A small village under Garhwal rule, it grew into a market town after the railway arrived in 1900, and the Jolly Grant airport lies close by. Homes are mostly independent houses on plots, with a few newer projects.

Doiwala railway station is on the Laksar-Dehradun line, with Harrawala as the next station towards Dehradun, so tutors can travel by train as well as by road. Because the town is outside the main city, families often find a home tutor among people living in Doiwala itself or along the highway, and use online classes for subjects where the right specialist lives in Dehradun. Give a clear landmark and phone number for the first visit, and keep the timing fixed. Traffic on the highway is heaviest at office hours, so plan the slot with some margin. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

vasant-vihar.name: Vasant Vihar
vasant-vihar.about:
Vasant Vihar is a developed residential area in west Dehradun, with good roads and a central position on the western side of the city. Its housing mixes apartment complexes of two to four bedrooms with builder floors, independent houses and plots, and two-bedroom flats are among the most sought-after homes. Indra Nagar Colony, Engineers Enclave, Kanwali Road, Ram Vihar, Mohit Nagar, Balliwala and Shivalik Puram are its neighbours.

Balliwala Chowk is the nearest main bus stop, and tutors from Ballupur, Kanwali, Indira Nagar or GMS Road can usually reach Vasant Vihar without crossing the busy centre. In apartment complexes, register the tutor at the gate and ask about visitor parking; independent houses and builder floors mean arrival at the door. Evening traffic builds around the main chowks, so a fixed weekday slot agreed in advance is easier to keep. In the colder winter evenings, many families prefer an earlier start, and online classes suit specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

indira-nagar.name: Indira Nagar (Indra Nagar Colony)
indira-nagar.about:
Indira Nagar, usually written Indra Nagar Colony, is a residential colony in west Dehradun with a large stock of plots and ready independent houses, and it has grown quickly in recent years. Vasant Vihar, Engineers Enclave, GMS Road, Seema Dwar and the Kanwali side lie around it, which places it in the main western housing belt of the city.

Because most homes here are independent houses, tutors can usually arrive straight at the door and park on the street outside; newer apartment buildings may ask visitors to sign in. Public transport is available along the main roads, and auto-rickshaws or shared three-wheelers cover the last stretch, though most tutors prefer a two-wheeler. Connecting roads get busy at peak hours, so an early-evening slot agreed in advance keeps classes regular. Neighbouring Vasant Vihar, Ballupur and GMS Road give families a wide pool of nearby tutors, and online sessions cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ballupur.name: Ballupur
ballupur.about:
Ballupur is a centrally placed area on the western side of Dehradun, built around Ballupur Chowk, one of the main junctions on the way west out of the city. A large forest research campus lies close by. Housing includes apartments, builder floors, plots and independent houses, with three-bedroom homes and builder floors in demand. Ram Vihar, Mohit Nagar, Vijay Park, Khurbura Mohalla, Shivalik Puram, Hem Kunj and Ashirwad Enclave are nearby, and GMS Road begins close to the chowk.

Ballupur Chowk is a planned stop on the proposed Metro Neo east-west corridor, but the project is not under construction, so tutors come by two-wheeler, car or auto. The junction is busy at office hours, so classes scheduled outside the evening peak start more reliably. For flats, share the building name and floor with the tutor; for houses, a lane landmark helps on the first visit. Being central to the western belt, Ballupur is within easy reach of tutors living in Vasant Vihar, GMS Road and Kanwali. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

gms-road.name: GMS Road
gms-road.about:
GMS Road is a busy road and residential area in west Dehradun that starts near Ballupur Chowk and has become a shopping and commercial stretch as well as a housing address. Homes include apartments of two to four bedrooms, some with penthouses, along with builder floors, independent houses, villas and plots, and offices and showrooms line the road. Hari Vihar, Mohit Nagar, Kanwali, Sewla Kalan, Indra Nagar Colony, Engineers Enclave, Seema Dwar, Shakti Enclave, Patel Nagar and Kaonli lie around it.

Many newer homes here are in apartment complexes with gate registration, so give the guard the tutor's name in advance. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler or car, and shared three-wheelers run along the main road. Because GMS Road also carries shopping traffic in the evening, a slot that starts early is easier to keep. Families in the lanes behind the main road have quieter access and doorstep arrival. Tutors living in Ballupur, Vasant Vihar or Kanwali are usually the most practical match. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kanwali.name: Kanwali
kanwali.about:
Kanwali is a growing residential locality in west Dehradun, between the GMS Road and Patel Nagar areas. Its housing covers apartments of two to four bedrooms, builder floors, independent houses, villas and plots, including some larger gated townships. Patel Nagar, Niranjanpur, Shivalik Puram, Balliwala, Dronpuri, Megh Enclave, New Forest and Smith Nagar are its neighbours.

Balliwala Chowk is the nearest main bus stop, and tutors from GMS Road, Vasant Vihar or Patel Nagar can reach Kanwali without going through the city centre. In gated townships, register the tutor at the main gate and ask whether a regular pass can be arranged after the demo; in independent houses the tutor can come straight to the door. Kanwali Road is busiest at office hours, so a fixed early-evening slot works well. In winter, when evenings get cold, many families shift classes earlier, and online tutors are a practical option for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

prem-nagar.name: Prem Nagar
prem-nagar.about:
Prem Nagar is a residential area on the western edge of Dehradun, reached mainly by Chakrata Road. Many ordinary families live here too, on green and fairly quiet streets. Plots and independent houses make up most of the housing, with builder floors, villas and a few apartment buildings. Nanda Ki Chowki, Shyampur, Sudhowala, Panditwari, Thakurpur, Badowala and Baronwala are among its neighbours.

Since Prem Nagar is some way out from the centre, the simplest arrangement is a tutor who lives in Prem Nagar itself or nearby along Chakrata Road. Most homes are independent houses, so the tutor arrives at the door and can park on the lane. Chakrata Road carries heavy traffic into the city at office hours, so evening classes with a local tutor are easier to keep than ones that depend on someone travelling out from the centre. Defence areas have their own entry rules, so families living inside them should check how a visitor is admitted. Online classes cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

patel-nagar.name: Patel Nagar
patel-nagar.about:
Patel Nagar is a locality in south-west central Dehradun, between the Saharanpur Road side and the city centre, known for its industrial area as well as its homes. Housing is mostly builder floors and independent houses, with two- and three-bedroom units in demand. Laxman Chowk, Dehrakhas, Pathribagh, Shakti Enclave, Lakkhi Bagh, Kaonli, Bhandari Bagh and Alaknanda Enclave are around it, and Kanwali and GMS Road lie to the west.

The proposed Metro Neo north-south corridor from the ISBT towards the city centre would pass nearby through stops such as Lalpul and Patthari Bagh, but it is still only planned. For now tutors come by two-wheeler or auto. Builder floors usually mean ringing the family's bell at the building door, so share the floor number in advance. Roads around the industrial area and the main chowks are busiest at shift and office times, so agree a regular slot outside those hours. Online classes help when the right subject tutor lives elsewhere. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

majra.name: Majra
majra.about:
Majra is a developing residential locality in south-west Dehradun, close to Saharanpur Road and the ISBT. Three-bedroom apartments are the most common homes, alongside independent houses, villas, builder floors and residential plots. Pitthuwala, Gangotri Vihar, Doon Enclave, Seema Dwar, Turner Road and Indra Nagar Colony lie around it, and the Chandrabani temple is a local landmark.

Saharanpur Road links Majra with the city, and the highway towards Saharanpur starts from this side of Dehradun. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler or auto, and the nearby ISBT makes it easy for someone travelling in from another part of the valley. Ask whether the home is a flat in a complex with gate registration or an independent house with doorstep arrival. Saharanpur Road is busy around the bus terminal at peak times, so a weekday slot outside the evening rush, with a tutor from Majra, Turner Road or GMS Road, works well. Online classes cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

turner-road.name: Turner Road
turner-road.about:
Turner Road is a residential area in south Dehradun, close to the ISBT and the Saharanpur Road side of the city. Independent houses make up much of its housing, alongside builder floors, apartments of two to four bedrooms and villas. Its neighbours include Clement Town, Subhash Nagar, Mohabbewala, Majra, Sewla Kalan, Brahmawala, Shimla Road and Shimla Bypass Road.

A new four-lane bypass is under construction on this side of the city, linking with the Delhi-Dehradun corridor, so some routes may change as work progresses. For now, tutors come by two-wheeler, car or auto, and the bus terminal nearby makes the area reachable for tutors travelling from further afield. Most visits are to independent houses with arrival at the door; apartment buildings may want the tutor's name at the gate. Traffic around the ISBT is heavy at peak times, so classes timed outside the evening rush start more reliably, and online sessions cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

clement-town.name: Clement Town
clement-town.about:
Clement Town is a cantonment town on the southern side of Dehradun, administered by its own cantonment board, and it borders Rajaji National Park. It is a quieter, greener part of the city with a strong Tibetan Buddhist presence: the Mindrolling Monastery here has a large stupa inaugurated in 2002 and a tall Buddha statue. Housing is mainly independent houses and villas, with some apartments. Turner Road, Subhash Nagar, Mohabbewala and Shimla Bypass Road lie close by.

Families living inside cantonment areas should check how visitors are admitted and give the tutor any pass or entry details before the first class; civilian colonies and apartment buildings usually just register visitors at the gate. Dehradun railway station is reached via Saharanpur Road, and most tutors come by two-wheeler, car or auto. Tutors from Turner Road or Subhash Nagar are the simplest match for regular evening classes. In the winter months, when it gets dark early, families often prefer an earlier slot, and online classes cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Rajpur Road & Dalanwala.fact: Rajpur Road, Chakrata Road, Saharanpur Road and Haridwar Road are the major internal roads of Dehradun.
Rajpur Road runs from the Dehradun city centre towards Mussoorie and lies in the 248001 postal area.
Rajpur village, at the upper end of the road, is the site of the Shahanshahi Ashram.
The Cantonment Board Dehradun was established in 1913, covers about 5,203 acres and has its office at Garhi Cantt.
Under the proposed Dehradun Metro Neo, both corridors would meet at an interchange at Ghantaghar (the Clock Tower); the DPR has been submitted and the project is not yet under construction.
In 2017, 72 adjoining villages were added to the Dehradun Municipal Corporation, increasing its wards from 60 to 100.

Sahastradhara & Raipur.fact: Raipur, on the east of the city, is home to defence production establishments.
The proposed Metro Neo east-west corridor (13.9 km, 15 elevated stations) would end at Raipur, with planned stations at Upper Nathanpur, Ordnance Factory and Hathikhana Chowk.
Sahastradhara Road lies in the Dehradun East zone with postal code 248013.
Kishanpur is in north Dehradun with postal code 248009, next to Canal Road, Govind Vihar, Rajpur and Jakhan.
The Rispana and Bindal are the principal watercourses flowing through the urban area, generally towards the south.

Haridwar Road.fact: National Highway 7 connects Dehradun with Rishikesh and the Himalayan region, passing through Doiwala towards Haridwar.
Doiwala is a nagar palika with 20 wards and a tehsil of Dehradun district; it grew into a market town after its railway station opened in 1900.
Doiwala railway station (DWO) is on the Laksar-Dehradun line in the Moradabad division of Northern Railway, between Harrawala and Kansrao.
Harrawala railway station (HRW), on the Laksar-Dehradun line, is situated at Balawala in Dehradun district.
Jolly Grant Airport (Dehradun Airport) is in Doiwala; commercial operations began in 2008 and a new terminal opened in 2021.
Planned stations on the proposed Metro Neo east-west corridor include Araghar Chowk and Nehru Colony.

Vasant Vihar & Chakrata Road.fact: Chakrata Road is one of the major internal roads of Dehradun and leads west from the city.
The proposed Metro Neo east-west corridor would begin in the west of the city with a station at Ballupur Chowk, then run east via Ghantaghar to Raipur.
Vasant Vihar lies in the Dehradun West zone with postal code 248006.
Kanwali lies in Dehradun West with postal code 248171, next to Patel Nagar, Niranjanpur, Shivalik Puram and Balliwala.

Saharanpur Road & Clement Town.fact: National Highway 307 connects Dehradun towards Saharanpur.
The Inter State Bus Terminal (ISBT) is the principal hub for intercity bus services, and electric city buses were introduced in 2022.
Dehradun railway station (DDN), in Govind Nagar, was established in 1899 and is the terminus of the Laksar-Dehradun line in the Moradabad division of Northern Railway.
Clement Town is a Category-II cantonment administered by a cantonment board and borders Rajaji National Park.
The large stupa of the Mindrolling Monastery in Clement Town was inaugurated on 28 October 2002.
The proposed Metro Neo north-south corridor (8.5 km, 10 elevated stations) would run from the ISBT via Sewla Kalan, ITI, Lalpul, Chamanpuri, Patthari Bagh and the railway station to Gandhi Park.
The final section of the Delhi-Dehradun Expressway crosses Rajaji National Park on an elevated wildlife corridor.
